description: "Calamities and Quarrels of Authors" by Isaac Disraeli is a literary exploration written in the early 19th century. The work delves into the tribulations faced by authors throughout history, discussing their struggles with poverty, lack of recognition, and the often tumultuous relationships between writers and their patrons.
